name: Meiji-Jingumae
tagline: Shibuya in 3 minutes and Shinjuku in 5 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, where JR East and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 16 minutes to Otemachi, 5 minutes to Shinjuku, 3 minutes to Shibuya and 18 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. The station stands 28.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 28.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 17 m to 33.8 m, a difference of 16.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is オリンピア会オリンピア眼科病院, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 伊藤病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line also call here. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 2 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. The JR Yamanote Line is boarded at Harajuku Station, about 5 minutes' walk away.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is not on. JR Yamanote Line (at Harajuku) runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line runs at 117%. Its busiest stretch is 要町→池袋, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 1K ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. 1LDK ¥320,000 to ¥330,000 and 2LDK ¥570,000 to ¥580,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road. Here the one-room figure comes out above the 1K figure. Because these are averages of listed properties, the order of the figures can differ from the order of the floor areas.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the highest in the 23 wards. What pushes the figure up: 3 lines and a wide choice of connections. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Omote-Sando; for quiet, Meiji-Jingumae.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Meiji-Jingumae. Both have the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line. Meiji-Jingumae adds the JR Yamanote Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line; Omote-Sando adds the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line and Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. Which is faster depends on where you are going: Meiji-Jingumae is 8 minutes quicker to Shinjuku, Omote-Sando is 7 minutes quicker to Toranomon. A one-room flat costs about ¥12,000 less at Omote-Sando. On the number of medical facilities, Omote-Sando comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Omote-Sando has 39 clinics and pharmacies and Meiji-Jingumae has 7.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Kita-Sando; for how close the centre is, Meiji-Jingumae.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Meiji-Jingumae in a straight line. Both have the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line. Meiji-Jingumae also has the JR Yamanote Line and Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line, which Kita-Sando does not. Meiji-Jingumae is at least 7 minutes quicker to Shinagawa and Roppongi. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥31,000 less at Kita-Sando.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People who want a large park within walking distance
notFor: People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 表参道 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
明治通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: The map data has far fewer supermarkets registered here than at nearby stations, so the count cannot be compared.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Mornings here are less crowded than the line figures suggest: the lines are busy, but this station is outside their busiest stretches.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
